issues.detail: The Hebrew 'בְּנֵי פֶרֶץ' is a proper name 'sons of Perez' (a clan/family name), but the Chinese renders it as '裂口的兒子' ('sons of the breach/tear'), which is a literal translation of the name's meaning rather than a proper name. This would mislead a Chinese reader into thinking it refers to 'sons of the breach' rather than the family of Perez.
